title: Add a Vercel AI SDK provider
prompt: Add Together AI as a model provider through the Vercel AI SDK. Use createOpenAICompatible from @ai-sdk/openai-compatible (name "together", baseURL "https://api.together.xyz/v1", API key from a new TOGETHER_API_KEY setting that defaults to an empty string and is kept secret) and register it in src/app.ts as the provider `together`, made into an Inferlo provider with Inferlo's own adapter for AI SDK providers. Add an alias `cheap` for the model meta-llama/Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct-Turbo of that provider, and keep the existing providers and aliases.
